subject: Startups
title: Theranos: Silicon Valley's Fraud
description: A 60-second lesson on Theranos: Silicon Valley's Fraud.

hook.text: Elizabeth Holmes raised $700 million by promising a blood-testing revolution. The technology was a lie.

buildup.text: Theranos claimed it could run 200+ tests from a single drop of blood.

discovery.text: The machines didn't work. Theranos secretly used standard equipment and diluted samples to fake results.

twist.text: A brave whistleblower and a Wall Street Journal reporter exposed the fraud.

climax.text: Holmes was convicted of four counts of fraud in 2022. She's now serving 11 years in federal prison.

punchline.text: Charisma raised the money. The product never existed.

quiz.question: What was wrong with Theranos's core technology?
options: It was too expensive to manufacture
The blood-testing devices didn't actually work
